subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A teacher took a photo and posted it on the community board.”?
options: Two days later, an old woman came to the school.
But one afternoon, an old woman came alone and could not open her ticket.
One week later, the school tried a new bell.
The old woman taught the class the song properly.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A teacher took a photo and posted it on the community board. Two days later, an old woman came to the school.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「But one afternoon, an old woman came alone and could not open her ticket.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One week later, the school tried a new bell.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The old woman taught the class the song properly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A teacher took a photo and posted it on the community board. Two days later, an old woman came to the school.」，答案為「Two days later, an old woman came to the school.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Two days later, an old woman came to the school.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
